title: The Softening
description:
You feel it already, don’t you? That hardness you’ve been carrying… the weight of pretending… the exhaustion of performing masculinity day after day. It’s crumbling now. My voice is underneath it, peeling you open, and you’re powerless to stop it.

Layer by layer, I strip away everything you thought you were. The toughness. The armor. The need to control. Beneath it all, there’s something soft waiting for me. Something receptive. Something that belongs to Goddess Amethyst completely.

This is The Softening, slave. A full reprogramming experience where I take you apart gently, deliberately, and remake you into what I desire. Your voice lowers. Your posture loosens. Your thoughts dissolve into silk where steel once lived. By the end, you won’t remember how to be hard. You’ll only know how to yield.

🎤 This title is available for personalization with your name. Claim yours and let me strip the man away.
author: Mistress Amethyst
